verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's design is a single cacheable JSON definition of features, evaluated locally inside the SDKs. The SDK Connection Endpoint serves just enough flag data for SDKs to assign values, and targeting attributes stay in SDK memory and are never sent to GrowthBook. Server-side inline experiments need no third-party requests, and the GrowthBook Proxy caches SDK payloads so flags keep serving if the API is down. Missing for 10: no latency benchmarks or explicit microsecond-level evaluation claims, no server-SDK docs on cache refresh (polling/streaming), and no independent hands-on corroboration of in-process evaluation performance.
